_slug_rules: EVERY field labelled *-slug MUST reference an id that exists in the corresponding top-level array in THIS JSON. If the entity doesn't exist yet, create it. NEVER put free-text, descriptive phrases, or parenthetical notes in slug fields. If no valid id applies, use null or omit the field.

novel.title: string
novel.type: cultivation | tower | regression | system | isekai | fantasy | sci-fi | light-novel | web-novel | other

characters.name: Full Name
characters.current_power_level: Final stage at end of novel
characters.cultivation_path: e.g. Sword Dao / Mage / F-Rank Hunter

relationships.type: rival | ally | master | disciple | family | love-interest | enemy | subordinate

characters.status: alive | dead | unknown | sealed | ascended | regressed

system_stats.note: Only for system/isekai novels. Omit otherwise.

power_system.name: e.g. Qi Cultivation / Hunter Ranks / Magic Tiers

tiers.name: Stage name
power_feats: What someone at this level can physically or magically do

daos_or_paths.name: e.g. Sword Dao / Path of Destruction

techniques.name: string
techniques.type: movement | attack | defense | sealing | healing | illusion | summoning | passive | skill | spell | ability

artifacts.name: string
artifacts.type: weapon | armor | ring | cauldron | formation | treasure | consumable | mount | tool | accessory
artifacts.current_owner: character-slug (MUST be a real character id or null — never free-text like 'Various')

pills_and_resources.name: string
pills_and_resources.type: pill | herb | ore | beast_material | potion | scroll | mana_crystal | formation_material
used_by: character-slug (only real character ids — omit if no specific named user)

beasts_and_creatures.name: string
beasts_and_creatures.type: spirit-beast | demon | ancient-creature | divine-beast | undead | elemental | monster | alien | floor-boss
beasts_and_creatures.tame_difficulty: Impossible | Very Hard | Hard | Moderate | Easy | N/A

locations.name: string
locations.type: city | sect | realm | dungeon | secret-realm | ancient-ruin | continent | mountain | tower-floor | world | dimension

factions.name: string
factions.type: sect | empire | clan | guild | party | religion | race | association | government
factions.standing: Major Power | Minor Power | Hidden Force | Extinct

battles_and_events.name: string
battles_and_events.type: battle | political | disaster | tournament | betrayal | discovery | ascension | regression-trigger | gate-opening
participants: character-slug (only ids of characters that have entries — put group descriptions in summary instead)
casualties: character-slug (only ids of characters that have entries)

arcs.title: string
arcs.power_level_context: MC stage at start and end of arc

prophecies_and_lore.title: string
prophecies_and_lore.type: prophecy | ancient-text | myth | legend | divine-decree | system-message

terminology.category: power-system | world-building | item | combat | political | race | other

character_analyses.fighting_style: How this character fights — patterns, preferred range, psychology in combat

move_breakdown.move_name: Technique name or unnamed described move
move_breakdown.type: signature | opener | finisher | desperation | counter | combo | passive-trigger
move_breakdown.description: What it looks like in combat
move_breakdown.conditions_used: When and why they use this move

character_analyses.power_scaling_notes: How their power grew arc by arc with context
character_analyses.character_arc_analysis: Emotional and moral journey throughout the novel
character_analyses.role_in_world: Their broader significance to the plot and world

power_rankings.title: e.g. Top 10 Strongest Characters at Peak

entries.peak_power: Stage or level at their absolute strongest
entries.reasoning: Detailed explanation for this ranking position

relationship_dynamics.dynamic_type: rivalry | romance | mentorship | betrayal | loyalty | foil | parallel
relationship_dynamics.analysis: Deep analysis of how this relationship evolved over the story

foreshadowing_analysis.payoff: What actually happened in the story

plot_patterns.pattern: e.g. Villain becomes ally, Power-up before boss fight, Death fake-out
occurrences: Arc or chapter where this pattern appeared
plot_patterns.analysis: Whether this trope was used effectively or felt repetitive

evidence: What in the novel text supports this insight
world_building_insights.significance: Why this matters to the world or story

thematic_analysis.author_message: What the novel as a whole seems to be saying

unanswered_questions.question: A plot point or lore detail left unresolved by the end
unanswered_questions.context: Where in the story this was raised
theories: Possible explanations supported by existing data
